items.name: pnl-attribution-report
items.title: P&L attribution report
items.description: Display of a native single-instrument P&L attribution: totals, factor buckets, a signed factor chart, the Rust waterfall steps, the residual and notes.
items.docs: Display-only view of a PnlAttribution as returned (by attribution.attributePnl / attributePnlMany, or inside scenarios.computeHorizonReturn): total, mark-to-market and endpoint values, every factor bucket as exact money with a signed bar chart of the returned amounts, the waterfall drawn only from Rust's waterfall_steps (pv_before to pv_after per step; nothing when the method returns none), the residual with the returned residual_pct and tolerances, notes, the policy stamp and the JSON. Optional explain, residualWithinTolerance and pctOfTotal props take Rust's pnlAttributionExplainText, pnlAttributionResidualWithinTolerance and pnlAttributionPctOfTotal; without residualWithinTolerance no verdict is shown. Nothing is summed, differenced or converted. Accepts attribution, loading, error and density props; no worker or query provider required.
